review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its main definitions against Mathlib and the sibling Formal Frontier files. The definitions are resolutionEval, swapCoind, diagonalCoind, insertCoind and coind₁Insert. Mathlib's RepresentationTheory directory has resolutionX, d, resolutionMap and coind₁Map in Homological/ContCohomology/Basic.lean, Homological/ContCohomology/Functoriality.lean and Continuous/Basic.lean. The file builds on these and does not redefine them. I found no Mathlib counterpart for iterated pointwise evaluation of resolutionX, for the swap and diagonal intertwining maps on coind₁.coind₁, or for the recursive insertion. A grep of the formal-frontier sources found these names only in this file, its example file, CochainExactness and CohomologyExactSequence. I saw no internal duplicate that could be consolidated. I did not search every Mathlib directory outside RepresentationTheory for a general curry/swap equivalence. Even if one exists, swapCoind is a named intertwining map, so I would not treat it as a competing concept.
